decisions.reason: The cleaning-method decision does not change the valve, dripping, or flow-control requirements; those separate clauses already have their own message-32 MODIFY.
Making the spout removable or flushable does not alter the existing requirement to prevent liquid from entering the base or electronics.
The source Event concerns spout cleaning; it does not modify the independently applicable leak-free seal requirement.
The removable-or-flushable cleaning requirement does not necessarily change the spout's bottom mounting, barista-facing orientation, or pouring access.
The spout cleaning method does not change the V1 strategy of using simple off-the-shelf electrical components.
The dispensing-path cleaning decision has no effect on the machine's green accent color.
The spout cleaning method does not change the required bowl depth or enclosure-size constraint.
The removable-or-flushable spout requirement does not alter the DJ-turntable visual theme.
The source decision does not necessarily alter the selected enclosure thickness or overall size constraint.
The dispensing-path cleaning method has no effect on the required machine placard text.
Spout removability or flushability does not modify the independently stated target of minimizing splashing during mixing.
